name: Chan ga cay
summary: Soft chicken feet soaked in a hot sauce of chili, garlic, and onion. A street snack, not a meal.
origin: Hoi An, as a street snack.
taste: The sauce is hot with chili, garlic, and onion.
howToEat: Eat it as a snack, not as the lunch.
seoTitle: Chan ga cay — spicy chicken feet in Hoi An
seoDescription: Chân gà cay in Hoi An is a soft chicken-foot snack in chili, garlic, and onion.
